name: marshal_inspect
description: Read a Python marshal stream (a .pyc, or a stream carved from a packed executable or memory) as data and never run it: its constants and every code object (names, file name, first line, flags, names used, constants, bytecode size, sha256 and bytecode hex). CPython 3.11 to 3.13 code objects; a .pyc header is skipped and dated. Bounded depth and counts; the whole tree goes to out_dir.

path.description: The file holding the stream (read only)

offset.description: Where the stream starts (default: after a .pyc header when the file begins with one, else 0)

out_dir.description: Where the whole result goes, inside the run directory and not under inputs/ (default work/<agent>/marshal_inspect)

preview.description: Characters of a string, or bytes of a byte string, shown in the answer (default 160); the result file holds them whole

bytecode.description: Put each code object's bytecode, as hex, in the result file (default true)

limit.description: Code objects shown in the answer (default 200); all are in the result file
